questions.question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

Neither she ______ I have expected Reema’s arrival.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**nor**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Nor" is used to introduce a second negative clause, following neither, indicating that the second option is not true either. **
 
• "Neither" is a negative conjunction that is used to introduce two negative alternatives.
 
• "Nor" is the appropriate option to complete the sentence as it is the negative counterpart of "or".
 
• In case of the given sentence, both the person did not know about the arrival of Reema.
 
• The correct sentence should read:
 
 
• "Neither she nor I have expected Reema's arrival."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (and) is not the correct option as it is a positive conjunction that connects two affirmative statements.
 
• Option 2 (along) is not the correct option as it does not make sense in the given context.
 
• Option 4 (or) is not the correct option as it is a positive conjunction that introduces a choice between two alternatives.

questions.question:

She ______ and left the room, carefully pulling the door shut.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**sighed**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank will indicate an action that took place in the past. Thus, a verb in past tense will be used.**
 
• **"Sighed" is the correct past tense form of the verb "sigh."**
 
 
• It means to emit a deep, audible breath expressing sadness, relief, tiredness, or a similar feeling.(आह भरी)
 
• Example: She sighed with disappointment.
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that the subject sighed before leaving the room, indicating a possible feeling of sadness or disappointment.
 
• The use of "carefully pulling the door shut" suggests that the subject was trying to avoid making noise or disturbing others.
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct, with subject-verb agreement and proper use of adverbs and prepositions.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many soldiers marched in ________ at the international border
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 **i.e. **uniform**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Uniform**" is a standard set of clothing worn by members of an organization while participating in that organization's activity, particularly pertinent to the military.
 
• Using "**uniform**" conveys the idea that the soldiers were dressed in a standardized manner, which is typical for soldiers.
 
• The term "**dress**" generally refers to attire but doesn't specifically denote the standardized clothing for soldiers.
 
• "**Fabric**" and "**clothes**" are too general and do not convey the idea of a standardized, cohesive appearance expected from soldiers.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **uniform**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: dress:** While "dress" can refer to clothing, it does not specifically imply the standardized attire of soldiers.
 
• **Option 3: fabric:** "Fabric" refers to material used to make clothes but does not imply a completed garment or the standard attire of soldiers.
 
• **Option 4: clothes: **"Clothes" are too general and do not capture the formal, standardized aspect of a military uniform.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The discussion led by the scientist was very ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**informative**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**informative**" is an adjective that describes something that provides useful or interesting information.
 
• The adverb "**very**" is used to modify adjectives in their base form, not their comparative or superlative forms.
 
• Options like "**more informative**" and "**most informative**" are incorrect here because they are not preceded by appropriate comparative structures (e.g., "than" or a list for comparison).
 
• "**Information**" is a noun, and using it directly after "very" would be grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The discussion led by the scientist was very **informative**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Use "**informative**" when describing events, lectures, or discussions that provide knowledge or insight.
 
• Example: "The documentary was highly informative and well-researched."
 
• The word "**very**" intensifies the adjective, and must be followed by an adjective in the correct degree.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Dubai is like an oasis ________ the middle of a desert.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'in'** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• A**preposition**is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun, or phrase to show direction, time, place, location, or to introduce an object.

 
 
• ​**Example: **"at", "in", "on", "upon" etc.​
 
 
 
• ​The preposition**'in'**is used to indicate location, to specify day, month, or year, to indicate color, shape, or size.
 
 
• ​Here in this sentence**'in'**is used to indicate location.*example:__ "__Water is **in **the container"​__*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use**'in'**to fill in the blank.

 

**The correct sentence will be:***​"__Dubai is like an oasis__*__***in***__*__the middle of a desert__".*

__
 
• Hence,** option 3**is the correct answer.​​​

​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• **Preposition **दिशा, समय, स्थान, स्थान, या किसी वस्तु का परिचय देने के लिए **'noun', pronoun, or 'phrase'** से पहले इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला शब्द या शब्दों का समूह है।

 
 
• **उदाहरण:** "at", "in", "on", "upon" etc.
 
 
 
• The preposition'in' रंग, आकार या आकार को इंगित करने के लिए, स्थान को इंगित करने के लिए **day, month or year **निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• यहाँ इस वाक्य में **'in'**स्थान को इंगित करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। उदाहरण:__

 __"Water is in the container"​__
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use'in'to fill in the blank.

​इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा: *​"__Dubai is like an oasis __*__*in *__*__the middle of a desert__".*

__
 
• अत:** विकल्प 3** सही उत्तर है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The scratches on her hands were clear signs of domestic violence, ______ and said that she got scratched by barbed wire fencing.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence indicates a contradiction **between the clear signs of domestic violence and the woman’s claim**.
 
• The phrase **“yet she lied”** fits the context as it introduces a **contrast between the evidence and her statement.**
 
• When constructing sentences that convey contrast,** conjunctions like “yet,” “but,” and “however” are often used.**
 
• It is important to ensure that the chosen conjunction aligns with the context to maintain the intended meaning.​
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence:** *The scratches on her hands were clear signs of domestic violence, yet she lied__ and said that she got scratched by barbed wire fencing*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, “and poverty,” and Option 4, “done a while ago,” do not logically fit the sentence structure.
 
• Option 3, “which was enough evidence,” and Option 4, “done a while ago,” do not introduce the necessary contrast.
